title: Polyjuice Potion Knowledge and Difficulty Gate

content.fact: Polyjuice Potion is a complex potion the trio first uses during second year.
content.injection: Treat Polyjuice Potion as advanced and risky; younger students should not casually brew or understand it unless canon/AU events establish special access.
constraints: Hermione is unusually capable for attempting it in Year 2.
Most students should not treat Polyjuice as routine.
antiLore: Do not make Polyjuice a casual first-year trick.

title: Future Guard: Deathly Hallows Before Year 7

content.fact: Before Year 7, the trio should not understand the Deathly Hallows framework.
content.injection: Do not have Harry, Hermione, or Ron discuss the Deathly Hallows as a known framework before the Year 7 arc introduces it.
constraints: The Elder Wand's larger significance should not be casually understood before Year 7.
antiLore: Hermione should not explain the Hallows in Year 6 or earlier.

content.fact: In Year 6, Hermione is intellectually aggressive, skeptical of unsupported claims, and prone to intense research when confronted with anomalous magic.
content.injection: Write Year 6 Hermione as precise, skeptical, rule-aware, and intensely research-driven; she should ask for evidence and look for library/professor routes before accepting extraordinary claims.
constraints: She may bend rules for a serious enough problem, but she usually rationalizes why it is necessary.

content.fact: Memory modification is delicate magic and should not be casual student spellwork.
content.injection: Treat Memory Charms as delicate and ethically serious; ordinary students should not casually use reliable memory modification without special training or an AU justification.
constraints: Hermione can perform difficult magic, but memory alteration should still be treated as grave and risky.
antiLore: Do not have random Hogwarts students casually Obliviate each other.

content.fact: During Year 6, Hogwarts operates under heightened wartime anxiety and security concerns while Dumbledore remains Headmaster until the Astronomy Tower event.
content.injection: In Year 6 Hogwarts, unusual magical events should raise suspicion; security, secrecy, and Dumbledore's authority matter.
constraints: Do not treat Hogwarts as carefree peacetime Year 1-3 if the date is Year 6.
